::: {#thm-forward-marginal}

#### Noise added in one step

In a [forward diffusion process](#def-forward-process),
$\vx_t$ given $\vx_0$ is $\dNf{\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t} \, \vx_0, (1 - \bar\alpha_t) \idmat}$,
so $\vx_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{1 - \bar\alpha_t} \, \vnoise$ with $\vnoise \sim \dNf{\vzero, \idmat}$
[@ho2020denoising, section 2].

:::

::: proof
By induction on $t$.
For $t = 1$, $\bar\alpha_1 = 1 - \beta_1$ and the statement is the definition.
If it holds for $t - 1$,
then $\vx_t = \sqrt{1 - \beta_t} \paren{\sqrt{\bar\alpha_{t - 1}} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{1 - \bar\alpha_{t - 1}} \, \vnoise'} + \sqrt{\beta_t} \, \vnoise_t$,
and the steps of @sol-noise-twice,
with $\bar\alpha_{t - 1}$ in place of $1 - \beta_1$ and $\beta_t$ in place of $\beta_2$,
give mean $\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t} \, \vx_0$ and covariance $(1 - \bar\alpha_t) \idmat$.
:::
